title: I Changed My Mind… | Dragonwilds Tier 8 Weapon Tier List
author: SuperStooob
chapters: Before You Spend a Tier 8 Ascension Core
description:
Appreciate you guys checking out the videos recently, means a lot!

Which weapons are worth your Tier 8 Ascension Cores? This RuneScape: Dragonwilds weapon tier list ranks the upgrades I'd prioritise across melee, magic and ranged - and the ones I'd leave until later.

I've revisited my Tier 7 rankings with Tier 8 stats, weapon effects and special attacks in mind. This time, ranged weapons get individual placements, including the Crystal Bow, and the Dragonbone Dagger joins the list.

Chapters:
00:00 Before You Spend a Tier 8 Ascension Core
00:31 Magic Weapon Tier List
02:54 Ranged Weapon Tier List
07:03 Two-Handed Weapon Tier List
10:14 One-Handed Weapon Tier List
13:54 Abyssal Whip vs Zombie Axe

The focus is upgrade priority for Tier 8 vestige and masterwork weapons. Tier 9 Kuldra raid rewards aren't included.

Testing note: I used a modded world to obtain the Tier 8 upgrades for these comparisons. Rankings reflect the stats and behaviour at the time of recording; future patches may change them.

Get the new Abyssal Whip (PL7 + PL8):
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=91PvLt9urYU

Previous Tier 7 weapon tier list:
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=GX1X7oW2nZc

Which weapon gets your first Tier 8 core? Tell me your choice—and which placement you'd change—in the comments.

Subscribe for more RuneScape: Dragonwilds guides, weapon comparisons and testing.

#RuneScapeDragonwilds #Dragonwilds #WeaponTierList
